description: This file is a script for post-installation setup of bundled plugins in a Node.js project, handling discovery of runtime dependencies, environment setup, and conditional installation of missing dependencies.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the given file path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to the package.json file for a given dependency.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies of bundled plugins by inspecting the extensions directory.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a sanitized environment object for running npm install without global or prefix configurations.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Determines if the current directory is the source checkout root based on existence of specific folders.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Checks if the postinstall script should run, based on environment and directory conditions.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function to execute postinstall steps: discovering dependencies and installing missing ones.
